<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <meta name="description" content="The personal website of Neel Pratap Singh from Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh. Read his biography, education and travel memories.">
  <meta name="author" content="Neel Pratap Singh">
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#090909">
  <title>Neel Pratap Singh | Personal Website</title>
  <meta property="og:title" content="Neel Pratap Singh | Personal Website">
  <meta property="og:description" content="A kind heart. A positive mind. A journey of learning and exploring.">
  <meta property="og:type" content="website">
  <style>
    :root{--bg:#090909;--panel:#121212;--gold:#e7bd61;--gold2:#b98a31;--text:#f5f0e6;--muted:#bcb6aa}
    *{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;line-height:1.65}
    a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.wrap{width:min(1120px,92%);margin:auto}
    header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:10;background:rgba(8,8,8,.94);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border-bottom:1px solid #8c692d}
    .nav{min-height:70px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px}.brand{font-size:1.25rem;color:var(--gold);font-weight:bold;letter-spacing:.04em}
    nav{display:flex;gap:22px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:.94rem}nav a:hover,.social:hover{color:var(--gold)}
    .hero{min-height:610px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;align-items:center;gap:30px;padding:70px 0 55px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
    .hero:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 75% 45%,#5b472b55,transparent 55%),linear-gradient(120deg,#090909,#17130e 60%,#090909);z-index:-1}
    .eyebrow{color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.78rem}.hero h1{font-size:clamp(2.8rem,6vw,5.4rem);line-height:1.02;margin:12px 0;color:var(--gold);text-transform:uppercase}
    .tagline{font-size:1.15rem;letter-spacing:.18em}.location{color:var(--muted);margin:18px 0 28px}
    .btn{display:inline-block;padding:11px 25px;border:1px solid var(--gold);border-radius:30px;color:var(--gold);transition:.2s}.btn:hover{background:var(--gold);color:#111}
    .portrait{justify-self:center;width:min(390px,90%);height:490px;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 22%;border:2px solid var(--gold);border-radius:180px 180px 22px 22px;box-shadow:0 20px 65px #000}
    section{padding:72px 0;border-top:1px solid #392c18}.section-title{text-align:center;color:var(--gold);font-size:clamp(2rem,4vw,3rem);margin:0 0 34px}
    .about-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:28px;align-items:stretch}.panel{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#171717,#0e0e0e);border:1px solid #594321;border-radius:18px;padding:28px}
    .panel h3{color:var(--gold);margin-top:0}.facts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:125px 1fr;gap:12px 15px}.facts strong{color:var(--gold);font-weight:normal}
    .travel-note{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);max-width:720px;margin:-18px auto 30px}
    .gallery{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px}.gallery figure{margin:0;background:#111;border:1px solid #594321;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden}
    .gallery img{width:100%;height:270px;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform .35s}.gallery figure:hover img{transform:scale(1.04)}
    figcaption{padding:10px 13px;color:var(--gold);text-align:center}
    .motto{text-align:center;font-size:1.5rem;color:var(--gold);font-style:italic}
    .contact{text-align:center}.contact p{color:var(--muted)}.social{display:inline-block;margin:8px;padding:10px 18px;border:1px solid #6b5126;border-radius:25px}
    footer{border-top:1px solid #8c692d;padding:24px 0;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem}
    @media(max-width:760px){.nav{padding:14px 0;align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}nav{gap:12px;font-size:.85rem}.hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;text-align:center;padding-top:48px}.portrait{height:420px;grid-row:1}.about-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.gallery{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.gallery img{height:210px}}
    @media(max-width:460px){.gallery{grid-template-columns:1fr}.gallery img{height:280px}.facts{grid-template-columns:105px 1fr}.portrait{height:390px}}
  </style>
  <script type="application/ld+json">
  {
    "@context":"https://schema.org",
    "@type":"Person",
    "name":"Neel Pratap Singh",
    "birthDate":"2009",
    "homeLocation":{"@type":"Place","name":"Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, India"},
    "alumniOf":{"@type":"EducationalOrganization","name":"Sant Pushpa Inter College, Dhadha Bujurg"},
    "sameAs":["https://www.instagram.com/thakur_neel_pratap/"]
  }
  </script>
</head>

          <p><strong>Neel Pratap Singh</strong> is a young individual from Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, India, born in 2009. He describes himself as kind-hearted, humble and positive, and believes in honesty, respect and treating people with kindness.</p>
          <p>He enjoys learning, making memories and exploring new places. For him, being a good human being matters most.</p>

            <strong>School</strong><span>Sant Pushpa Inter College, Dhadha Bujurg</span>
            <strong>Education</strong><span>Class 10 and Class 12 completed</span>
            <strong>Personality</strong><span>Kind-hearted and positive</span>
          </div>
        </article>
